name: Network Layer Recovery
description: Reopens file-based layers on network drives after Windows sleep/hibernate, so rasters render and vectors become editable again without restarting QGIS.
about:
When a project is opened from an SMB share / mapped network drive and the PC sleeps, the GDAL/OGR handles held by QGIS go stale. Even after Windows reconnects the share, some rasters fail to render and some vector layers cannot be edited.
This plugin detects system resume (Windows power notifications plus a wall-clock gap fallback), waits until the network shares are reachable again (probing in a background thread so QGIS never freezes) and then reopens the data provider of every affected layer. Layers in edit mode are never touched automatically.
A manual "Recover network layers" command and a "Recover selected layers" command are also provided.

name: Map Themes Evolved
description: Searchable, folder-based map theme browser on the Layers panel eye button — fully compatible with native map themes.
about: Replaces the flat "Manage Map Themes" menu with a popup that has instant search, nested folders, drag and drop and one-click "Update theme". Folders are just part of the theme name ("Area/Topic/Theme"), so projects stay 100% compatible with plain QGIS: the themes remain normal map themes, and the plugin's extras (custom order, open folders, highlight colors, layer visibility history) are separate project properties that QGIS ignores. English and Hungarian. Includes undo, a dockable panel, and keeps all native layer-visibility actions plus the classic menu (right-click the eye button).

name: Layer Theme Manager
description: Manage QGIS layer/map themes with rename, duplicate, edit, import, export, clipboard, and batch tools.
about: Fast manager for the map themes of the current QGIS project: create, activate, edit, rename, duplicate, batch rename, delete, import/export and copy/paste themes. Marks the theme that matches the current map, searches by theme or layer name and remembers its window size and position across monitor and resolution changes.

name: Topological Paste
description: Paste clipboard features into the active layer with overwrite semantics: pasted coverage wins, existing features underneath are trimmed (not duplicated), everything as one undoable edit.
about: Pastes the geometries and attributes on the QGIS clipboard into the active vector layer. Pasted features take priority: their coverage is cut out of the existing features underneath, existing features are deleted only when nothing of them remains, surviving portions keep their attributes, identical geometries are reused instead of duplicated, shared boundaries are consistently noded, and the whole operation is a single Undo step. A preview is shown before anything is changed. Works with polygons (main use case: cadastral / zoning layers), lines and points. Requires no external Python packages.

name: Visible Layers Only
description: Adds a toggle button to the Layers panel toolbar that lists only the currently visible layers.
about: Adds a checkable button to the native Layers panel toolbar. When enabled, the Layers panel hides every layer (and every group without visible content) that is not currently shown on the map canvas. It only changes what the panel displays: layer visibility, order and project contents are never modified. Works on QGIS 3.x (Qt5) and QGIS 4.x (Qt6).

name: Import Layouts from Project
description: Import all or selected print layouts (and reports) from another .qgs/.qgz project into the current project.
about:
Pick a .qgs or .qgz project, choose one or more of its layouts and import them into the current project.
Layer references (map layer sets, legends, atlas coverage layers, attribute tables, expressions) are
remapped to the layers of the current project: by layer ID when it matches, otherwise by layer name,
and finally by data source. The proposed mapping can be reviewed and overridden before importing.
The source project is only parsed, its layers are never loaded.
Available from the Plugins menu and from the Layout menu of the layout designer.

name: Virtual Layer Guard
description: Prevents QGIS from silently dropping virtual (and other dependent) layers from the project file.
about: If any layer of a project depends on a layer ID that no longer exists (for example after deleting or replacing a layer, changing data sources, or moving layers between projects), QGIS skips EVERY layer that has a dependency while loading the project, without an error message. Virtual layers always have dependencies. The skipped layers keep their name in the Layers panel, and the next save removes their definition from the project file for good. This plugin removes dependencies on missing layers on every save, keeps definitions QGIS would drop, restores skipped layers automatically when a project is opened, keeps a copy of every virtual layer definition for later recovery, and warns when removing a layer or changing its data source breaks a virtual layer. The user interface is English or Hungarian, following the QGIS language.

name: Cross-Instance Layer Drag
description: Keeps layer IDs and copies memory-layer features when dragging layers between two running QGIS instances.
about: When a layer is dragged from the Layers panel of one QGIS process to another, QGIS assigns a new layer ID and memory (temporary scratch) layers arrive empty. This plugin intercepts such drops: the original layer ID is kept unless it already exists in the target project (then only that layer gets a new ID and references are rewritten), and memory-layer features, including unsaved edits, are copied through a temporary GeoPackage snapshot. Groups, styles and layer settings are transferred as well. Works when dropping on the Layers panel or on the map canvas. Install and enable it in BOTH QGIS instances. The user interface is English or Hungarian, following the QGIS language.

name: Theme Compare
description: Compare two map themes (or a theme and the current, unsaved map view) side by side.
about: Shows which layers and groups are visible in one map theme but not in the other. Either side can be the current state of the Layers panel, so you don't have to save it as a theme first. Optionally also compares named styles, switched-on legend classes (categories/rules) and the expanded/collapsed state. Differences can be filtered, exported to CSV, copied to the clipboard, and copied from one theme to the other with a right click.

name: Safe Layer Remover (Biztonságos rétegtörlés)
description: Remove layers from the project without breaking any other layer. / Rétegek törlése a projektből úgy, hogy egyetlen más réteg se romoljon el.
about: Maps the dependencies between layers (joins, virtual layers, relations, value relations, expressions, group layers, print layouts etc.), marks layers that cannot be removed safely in red together with the reason, and only allows removing safe layers, with a recycle bin and undo. English and Hungarian user interface (follows the QGIS language). / Feltérképezi a rétegek közötti függőségeket (join, virtuális réteg, kapcsolat, értékreláció, kifejezések, csoportréteg stb.), pirossal jelöli a nem törölhető rétegeket az okkal együtt, és csak a biztonságos rétegek csoportos törlését engedi. Lomtárral és visszavonással.

name: AutoCAD Clipboard Exporter
description: Copy selected features to the clipboard as an AutoLISP script (entmake POINT / LWPOLYLINE), ready to paste into the AutoCAD command line.
about: Converts the selected features of the active layer (or of the layers selected in the Layers panel) into an AutoLISP script, in the project CRS. Each QGIS layer becomes an AutoCAD layer (with its color for single-symbol layers); points become POINTs, lines and polygon rings become 2D polylines. Paste into the AutoCAD command line (click in it, then Ctrl+V). Needs AutoLISP (full AutoCAD or AutoCAD LT 2024+). The current layer, object snaps and UCS do not affect the result, and the whole paste is one UNDO step. Counterpart of AutoCAD Clipboard Importer.

name: Topology Workbench
description: Searchable layer selection, background topology checks and exportable issues.
about: Topology workbench with saved rules, map highlighting, CSV and GeoPackage export. English and Hungarian interfaces follow the QGIS language. Supports QGIS 3 and Qt6-based QGIS 4.

name: Virtual Clip
description: Clip any vector layer with a polygon layer on the fly, as a live virtual layer (no data is copied).
about:
Creates a QGIS virtual layer that clips (or erases) the features of any point, line or polygon layer with the dissolved polygons of a mask layer. The result is a live SQL view: it follows every edit of the source and of the mask layer. Layers are picked with searchable combo boxes (case insensitive, substring match), the symbology of the source layer is copied to the result, and differing layer CRSs are handled by transforming the mask on the fly.
Hungarian: Tetszőleges vektoros réteget vág le virtuálisan (élő virtuális rétegként) egy poligon réteggel.

name: Project Time Tracker
description: Tracks active working time on QGIS projects with idle detection and persistent storage.
about: This plugin tracks how much time you actively work on each QGIS project. It detects idle periods and pauses automatically. Time is stored in the project file itself, so it travels with the project.

name: Visible Layers Locator
description: Locator filter (prefix: 'vls') to search among effectively visible layers in the current project.
about: Adds a Locator bar filter that searches only layers that are effectively visible in the Layers panel (the layer and all parent groups checked). Selecting a result selects the layer in the Layers panel. Works with QGIS 3 (Qt5) and QGIS 4 (Qt6).

name: Layer Group Locator Plugin
description: Registers a locator filter that searches for layer groups by name (case insensitive) and jumps to the group in the layer legend.
about: The Layer Group Locator Plugin is a QGIS plugin that enhances your workflow by allowing you to quickly search for layer groups within your current project. By using a simple prefix (grp), this plugin integrates with the QGIS locator system to find and highlight any layer group whose name matches your query, making project navigation fast and efficient.

name: AutoCAD Clipboard Importer
description: Paste AutoCAD clipboard (DWG) → DXF → memory layers, added to the project. Windows only.
about: Pastes AutoCAD clipboard content by discovering the temp DWG, converting via LibreDWG dwg2dxf.exe, fixing geometries, and loading memory layers. The dwg2dxf.exe path is stored in plugin options and can be set in Settings → Options → Plugins. Icon by Laisa Islam Ani.

name: Update Fields From Expression
description: Update selected features by parsing simple assignments (field1 = field2 or field1 = "literal"), with a recent-expressions list.
about: Update selected features from a compact expression. Unquoted RHS that matches a field name copies from that field (case-insensitive). Quoted strings are used as literals. Remembers recent expressions.

name: Equalyzer - Split Polygons into Equal Areas or Parts
description: Branch-aware planar polygon splitting with strictly parallel straight cuts and clickable preview highlighting
about: Equalyzer - Split Polygons into Equal Areas or Parts. Select a polygon on the current layer, choose either of the two options (equal area/equal parts) and after processing it creates a memory layer with the expected division.

name: autoSaver
description: Automatic project (and edited layer) saving at a fixed interval or after inactivity
about: Fork of Enrico Ferreguti's autoSaver. Saves the current project at a fixed interval with a countdown on the message bar (skip / postpone), optionally to a separate *.bak.qgz backup file, and optionally after a period of user inactivity. Modified layers in edit mode can be committed as well. A toolbar label shows the time left until the next autosave.

name: Hungarian Cadastral CRS Detector
description: Régi magyar kataszteri térképek vetületének felismerése és georeferálása EOV-illesztőpontok alapján
about: A plugin EOV-koordinátájú illesztőpontok alapján rangsorolja a lehetséges történeti magyar vetületi rendszereket (budapesti sztereografikus, marosvásárhelyi sztereografikus, HÉR/HKR/HDR hengervetületi rendszerek, EOV kontrolljelölt), robusztus Helmert- és affin illesztéssel, térbeli keresztvalidációval és bootstrap-bizonyossággal. Megfelelő bizonyosság esetén georeferálja a rasztert a kiválasztott történeti CRS-ben, majd valódi koordináta-transzformációval EOV-ba vetíti. Részletes HTML/JSON/CSV jelentést, residual GeoPackage-et és maradékhiba-rétegeket készít. Nem igényel SciPy, scikit-learn, OpenCV vagy pyproj csomagot; a QGIS-szel szállított PyQGIS, GDAL és NumPy elegendő.

name: QConsolidate3
description: QConsolidate3
about: QConsolidate3 is a modified version of QConsolidate (https://github.com/alexbruy/qconsolidate) and OQ-Consolidate (https://github.com/gem/oq-consolidate), that copies raster layers and converts vector layers to GeoPackage or ESRI ShapeFile, creates a project if it does not exist yet, allows to give a customized (validated) name to the consolidated project, allows to store all the project files in a zip file

name: Memory Layer Saver (Danzig fork)
description: Makes memory layers persistent. Fork of Memory Layer Saver by Chris Crook and Yoann Quenach de Quivillic.
about:
This is a fork of Memory Layer Saver, which can be installed next to the original but only one should be enabled (original: https://github.com/YoannQDQ/qgis-memory-layer-saver), by Chris Crook and Yoann Quenach de Quivillic. Please report problems with this version to the fork, not to the original authors.
Makes memory layers persistent so that they are restored when a project is closed and reopened.
The memory provider data is streamed in a portable binary format (QDataStream) and embedded
in the project attachments (inside the qgz archive, or in attachments.zip for unzipped projects).

name: QWebMap
description: Publish a QGIS project as a fast web map that keeps its QGIS look: most QGIS symbology (patterns, SVG icons, marker lines, dashes, labels) is converted accurately to vector tiles, with a full web viewer and one-click publishing to Cloudflare R2 or other S3-compatible storage.
about: QWebMap turns a QGIS project into a public web map that looks like it does in QGIS. Its core is an accurate converter of QGIS symbology to vector tiles and a MapLibre style: categorized, graduated and rule-based renderers, hatches, point/SVG pattern fills, gradient and shapeburst fills, marker lines at the QGIS positions, dashes, arrows, SVG and font markers, and labels in your own fonts; most of what the browser cannot draw natively is rendered by QGIS into sprites or pre-computed geometry, the rest is approximated or left out, and every export writes a fidelity report. Its Publish Web Map window builds vector tiles in one PMTiles archive (QGIS-accurate styling: marker-line positions, patterns, dashes, labels, with a fidelity report), raster layers as image tiles, an optional OpenStreetMap vector basemap or web (XYZ) basemaps, map themes as views and a full modern viewer (layers, legend, popups, search, filters, permalinks, measuring with snapping, printing). It publishes with verification to Cloudflare R2 or other S3-compatible storage at a stable address, and keeps all settings in the project. No map server needed. QWebMap is developed by Ábel Kőszeghy. It started as a fork of QGIS2VectorTiles by Jossef Kanter (https://github.com/GallPeters/QGIS2VectorTiles), whose converter is still its foundation; its Processing tool still exports a static vector tile package.

name: Layer Color Plugin 2
description: This plugin enables users to customize the background colors of layers and groups in the layer tree view, enhancing visual organization and project management.
about: It streamlines the organization and management of complex QGIS projects by allowing users to visually distinguish different layers or groups through custom background colors. This plugin adds a menu called "Layer Highlight Color", located above the "Properties" in the "Layer Properties" menu. Always choose pastel or lighter colors. The code implements "WCAG 2.0" contrast ratio checking to avoid colors that can make hard to read the layer text.

name: Selection Sets Reloaded
description: Plugin for saving and loading selection sets for layers.
about: Adds the ability to save and load sets of selections. Based on the work of Nathan Woodrow and Thomas Baumann. Added a few features and fixed some bugs.

name: AttributeAssignment
description: AttributeAssignment
about: Easy to assign an attribute on QGIS

name: Split Polygon
description: Split polygon is a QGIS plugin developed to solve the problem of dividing polygons into different ways
about: Split polygon is a QGIS plugin developed to solve the problem of dividing polygons into different ways. This can be very useful in jobs like land parceling and many others. The user can define 4 ways of dividing by himself. The offered options of division are: - one cut by entered area - one cut once by entered percentage of polygons area - multiple cuts into equal parts - multiple cuts into parts with an equal width
